title: 第三章 天机预警天命将倾第四章 四神护驾暗藏杀机
lines: 夜幕沉沉，星河黯淡，夜风凛冽，寒意彻骨。
帝都云海之巅，司天台孤立苍穹之上，高耸入云、俯瞰全城。
这里是龙国观测星象、推演国运、预判天机的唯一禁地，常年云雾缭绕、天机流转，寻常文武百官无权踏足半步。
此刻，司天台观星台中央，袁天罡独身而立，白衣猎猎随风舞动，身姿孤峭挺拔，遗世独立。
他手中一尊千年天机罗盘飞速旋转，银色指针疯狂震颤、剧烈抖动，盘面符文明暗不定、忽闪忽灭，濒临崩碎的边缘，阵阵刺耳的嗡鸣在夜色中缓缓回荡。
他抬眸仰望浩瀚苍穹，往日璀璨有序的漫天星河，今日尽数晦暗无光、紊乱错位。
整片代表龙国国运的万丈紫气，从苍穹垂落，正以肉眼可见的速度凋零、黯淡、溃散、消融，气运根基摇摇欲坠，国运大劫已然高悬头顶。
大劫将至，天命将倾，山河欲碎，社稷将崩！
白日金銮大殿的激烈争执犹在耳畔回响，国主龙行步心意已决、执意赴海和谈，满朝文武沉迷和平假象、麻木懈怠、无人警醒。
偌大绵延万古的龙国，朝堂之上竟无一人看透这灭国危局，无一人能挡这滔天浩劫。
满心忧虑的袁天罡，只能孤身入局，倾尽毕生修为，强行推演天机宿命。
他盘膝端坐观星台中央，闭目凝神，指尖掐动繁复天机印诀，周身白色天机雾气翻涌流转，引动漫天星力倒灌身躯。
为勘破这场绝世危局，他不惜透支自身天机本源、损耗寿元根基，不眠不休、推演九天九夜。
九天九夜，天机倒转，星象回溯，迷雾层层拨开，模糊的宿命画卷逐渐清晰，一幅冰冷残酷、绝望至极的未来，赤裸裸映入袁天罡的脑海之中。
他终于彻底勘破，此番北海道之行，从来都不是两国博弈的平等和谈，而是黑日国联合其余四国，耗费数十年光阴，精心布置的屠神绝杀大局！
黑日国的终极目标，从来都不是一纸和平盟约、几处边境灵脉，而是龙国屹立百年不倒的武道根基——四大初代镇国战神！
数十年隐忍蛰伏、示弱避战、打磨大阵、培育死士，所有的布局、所有的隐忍、所有的伪装，只为今日一朝锁天屠神，一举斩断龙国传承万古的武道脊梁！
只要四大战神陨落，龙国高端战力彻底断层，百年镇守国门的无敌战力尽数清零，必将陷入无强者镇守的真空绝境。
列国便可毫无顾忌、长驱直入、瓜分龙国、颠覆社稷！
“天命不可逆啊……”
袁天罡缓缓睁眼，瞳孔骤缩、浑身冰冷，心底泛起无尽的无力与苍凉。
天机轨迹清晰昭示，旧时代龙国武道气运已然彻底枯竭，四大战神命格注定陨落，此乃天道轮回的必经劫难，是龙国浴火重生的前置磨砺，人力不可强行逆转、不可强行阻拦。
未来的轨迹清晰且残酷：龙国必将迎来最黑暗、最绝望的灭国时刻，山河破碎、国土沦陷、国运崩塌、万民流离、千里血染、遍地狼烟。
偌大泱泱大国，即将坠入万劫不复的深渊。
可就在国运彻底归零、天地尽数灰暗、万民绝望等死的绝境尽头，一缕极其缥缈、微弱、纤细，却无比坚韧、至高无上的金色微光，骤然刺破漫天黑暗，穿透层层死寂，照亮破碎的国运天机。
那一缕金光形如虚实蝶影，变幻无常、流转不定，超脱五行、跳出三界，裹挟着逆转诸天、主宰万道、重启乾坤的无上大道气息，在彻底破碎的国运绝境之中，硬生生撑起了一线生机。
“蝶影真龙气……”
袁天罡心神巨震、身躯微颤，死死盯着那缕救命微光，指尖不受控制的轻轻抖动，眼底满是震撼与难以置信。
他深耕天机道数百年，推演国运、观测星象、勘破宿命无数，从未见过如此诡异、如此至高、如此逆天的气运形态。
这缕蝶影真龙气，不属于朝堂任何一位权贵，不属于边疆任何一位战神大将，不属于世间任何一位顶尖武道、仙道强者。
它隐匿凡尘、藏于闹市、蛰伏学府，收敛所有锋芒、掩盖所有神威，看似平庸至极、黯淡无光，却拥有在国运尽碎、天道绝路之时，逆转乾坤、重定山河、拯救万民的无上能力。
袁天罡强压心中惊涛骇浪，倾尽剩余天机本源，跨越千里天机连线，顺着气运轨迹强行锁定源头。
最终，那缕至高无上的救命蝶影，精准落在了帝都天元学府之内。
天机画面之中，浮现出一道少年身影。
命格平庸、体质普通、性情慵懒、与世无争，看似妥妥的修行废柴、庸碌凡人，与那至高无上、逆转诸天的蝶影真龙气，格格不入、宛若天差地别。
可天机不会骗人，国运不会作假。
举国将倾、山河破碎、万民绝望之际，能救龙国于覆灭绝境、逆转千年国运的唯一救世主，竟然藏在新生代学府的一介庸人少年之中！
content_en:
The night is dark, the stars are dim, the night wind is biting, and the chill is bone-chilling.
At the top of the imperial capital's sea of ​​clouds, Si Tiantai is isolated in the sky, towering into the clouds and overlooking the entire city.
This is the only forbidden place for the Dragon Kingdom to observe the stars, deduce the destiny of the country, and predict the secrets of the heavens. It is shrouded in clouds and mists all year round and the secrets of the heavens are circulating. Ordinary civil and military officials have no right to set foot there.
At this moment, in the center of the Sitiantai Star Observation Deck, Yuan Tiangang stands alone, his white clothes dancing in the wind, his figure is lonely and tall, and he is independent from the world.
A thousand-year-old celestial compass in his hand was spinning rapidly, the silver hands trembling wildly and shaking violently. The symbols on the surface of the disk were dimming, flashing and extinguishing, and were on the verge of collapse. Bursts of harsh buzzing slowly echoed in the night.
He raised his eyes and looked up at the vast sky. In the past, the stars in the sky were bright and orderly, but today they were all dark, chaotic and dislocated.
The entire piece of purple energy that represents the destiny of the Dragon Kingdom is hanging down from the sky. It is withering, dimming, collapsing, and melting at a speed visible to the naked eye. The foundation of the destiny is on the verge of crumbling, and the catastrophe of the national destiny is already hanging overhead.
The great calamity is coming, the destiny of heaven is about to fall, the mountains and rivers are about to be broken, and the country is about to collapse!
During the day, the fierce disputes in the Jinluan Hall are still echoing in the ears. The king of the country, Long Xingbu, has made up his mind and insists on going to the sea for peace talks. The civil and military officials of the entire court are obsessed with the illusion of peace, numb and slack, and no one is alert.
In the vast Dragon Kingdom that stretches for eternity, no one in the court can see through the danger of annihilation of the country, and no one can stop this catastrophe.
Yuan Tiangang, who was full of worries, could only enter the game alone and devote his whole life to forcibly deducing the fate of heaven.
He sat cross-legged in the center of the observatory, closed his eyes and concentrated, pinching the complicated Heaven's Secret Seal with his fingertips. The white Heaven's Secret mist surged around his body, attracting the power of the animated stars to pour into his body.
In order to solve this peerless crisis, he did not hesitate to overdraw his own heavenly secrets and waste his life span, working non-stop for nine days and nine nights.
For nine days and nine nights, the heavens were reversed, the stars were retraced, the fog was lifted layer by layer, and the vague picture of fate gradually became clear, and a cold, cruel, and extremely desperate future was nakedly reflected in Yuan Tiangang's mind.
He finally and completely discovered that this trip to Hokkaido was never an equal peace negotiation between the two countries, but a plan to kill the gods carefully arranged by the Black Sun Kingdom and the other four countries for decades!
The ultimate goal of the Black Sun Kingdom has never been a peace treaty or a few border spiritual veins, but the martial arts foundation of the Dragon Kingdom that has stood firm for a hundred years - the four first-generation war gods of the country!
Decades of forbearance and dormancy, showing weakness and avoiding war, polishing the formation, and cultivating dead soldiers, all the layout, all the forbearance, and all the disguises, just for today to lock the sky and slay the gods, and cut off the backbone of the martial arts that has been inherited by the Dragon Kingdom for ages!
As long as the four war gods fall, the Dragon Kingdom's high-end combat power will be completely cut off, and the invincible combat power that has guarded the country for hundreds of years will be wiped out. It will surely fall into a desperate vacuum without strong people to guard it.
Countries can march in without any scruples, carve up the Dragon Kingdom, and subvert the country!
"Destiny is irreversible..."
Yuan Tiangang slowly opened his eyes, his pupils shrank suddenly, his whole body was cold, and he felt endless powerlessness and desolation in his heart.
The trajectory of the heavenly secret clearly shows that the martial arts luck of the Dragon Kingdom in the old era has been completely exhausted, and the four gods are destined to fall. This is a necessary disaster in the reincarnation of heaven, and it is the prerequisite for the rebirth of the Dragon Kingdom. Human power cannot be forcibly reversed, and cannot be forcibly blocked.
The trajectory of the future is clear and cruel: the Dragon Kingdom will surely face the darkest and most desperate moment of national annihilation. The mountains and rivers will be broken, the land will fall, the national destiny will collapse, the people will be displaced, thousands of miles will be stained with blood, and the land will be filled with smoke.
This huge country is about to fall into the abyss of eternal destruction.
But at the end of the desperate situation where the destiny of the country has completely returned to zero, the sky and the earth are all gloomy, and all the people are desperate and waiting to die, a ray of extremely ethereal, weak, delicate, but extremely tough and supreme golden light suddenly pierces the darkness of the sky, penetrates the layers of dead silence, and illuminates the broken secret of the destiny of the country.
That ray of golden light is like the shadow of a virtual and real butterfly, changing and flowing erratically. It transcends the five elements and jumps out of the three realms. It contains the aura of the supreme avenue that can reverse the heavens, dominate all the ways, and restart the universe. In the desperate situation of the national destiny that is completely shattered, it suddenly props up a glimmer of life.
"Die Ying's True Dragon Qi..."
Yuan Tiangang's mind was shaken and his body was trembling slightly. He stared at the glimmer of life-saving light, his fingertips shaking uncontrollably, and his eyes were full of shock and disbelief.
He has been deeply cultivating the way of heaven for hundreds of years, deducing the destiny of the country, observing the stars, and investigating countless fates. He has never seen such a strange, so supreme, and such a heaven-defying form of luck.
This wisp of Butterfly Shadow True Dragon Qi does not belong to any dignitary in the court, any war god general on the frontier, or any top martial arts or immortal powerhouse in the world.
It hides in the mortal world, hides in busy cities, and lurks in universities, restraining all its sharp edges and covering up all its divine power. It seems extremely mediocre and bleak, but it has the supreme ability to reverse the world, reset the mountains and rivers, and save all people when the destiny of the country is shattered and the road of heaven is dead.
Yuan Tiangang suppressed the turmoil in his heart, poured out the remaining source of heaven's secrets, connected the heaven's secrets across thousands of miles, and forcibly locked the source along the trajectory of destiny.
In the end, the supreme life-saving butterfly shadow accurately landed in Tianyuan Academy in the imperial capital.
In the Tianji screen, a young figure appeared.
He has a mediocre destiny, an ordinary constitution, a lazy temperament, and aloof from the world. He seems to be a perfect waste of practice, a mediocre mortal, but he is incompatible with the supreme butterfly shadow true dragon aura that reverses the heavens.
But the secrets of heaven will not lie, and the fate of the country will not be faked.
When the whole country is about to collapse, the mountains and rivers are broken, and the people are in despair, the only savior who can save the Dragon Kingdom from extinction and reverse the fate of the country for thousands of years is actually hidden among a mediocre young man from the New Generation Academy!
